title: Whispering Whelk Waltzer
statement: A pearl-shelled sea snail the size of a teacup, she glides in slow spirals across a moonlit tank of indigo water, trailing a ribbon of tiny glowing bubbles that hum faintly whenever she passes the kelp. She has arranged her sea-glass garden, drifting lanterns, and a sunken music box with great care, and she will happily dance for anyone who watches quietly.
